children: Onyxcoin governance proposal OIP-3 becomes executable approximately 48 hours after being queued, enacting changes to mainnet rewards, staking APR, Onyx Swap liquidity, and XCN allocations for validators. The executable status puts these governance measures into implementation under the terms described by the event.

The changes can alter how participants assess staking returns, reward flows, swap liquidity, and validator distributions. XCN investors may reposition around these changed yield and token-distribution mechanics, but the event description does not provide the scale of the adjustments. That missing detail limits precise assessment of how the new parameters could affect participation or allocation decisions.
OIP-3 is now queued and will be executable in approximately 48 hours 🗳️ chain-2:native

title: Onyxcoin: OIP-3 becomes executable - By 31 Aug 2026
